$comment: PAP-31 local-first sync rubric. Weights agreed with Atlas on the issue; criteria are the ones the spec lists. Scores are 0-5, weighted total is out of 100.

scale.1: possible only with significant custom work and residual risk
scale.2: works but fights the PaperOS contracts

hardCriteria: Self-hosts in Docker on the VPS (no mandatory cloud).
Licence acceptable under PAP-212 tiers (OSI licence, or source-available with a recorded re-open trigger).
Runs in the Tauri 2 WebView on desktop and Android.
Does not require Postgres superuser and does not force RLS to be disabled on the source database.
